title: Finding Your Reading Rhythm
subtitle: 长篇匹配示例

paragraphs.en: Set aside a fixed time for reading. Connecting reading to an existing routine can help you remember to do it.
paragraphs.zh: 为阅读安排固定的时间。将阅读与现有的日常安排联系起来，可以帮助你记得去做。
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.en: Choose material that interests you. Curiosity makes difficult passages feel more rewarding.
paragraphs.zh: 选择你感兴趣的材料。好奇心会让阅读困难的段落更有收获感。
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.en: Write a short summary after reading. Explaining the main idea in your own words helps you check your understanding.
paragraphs.zh: 阅读后写一段简短的总结。用自己的话解释主旨有助于检验理解程度。
paragraphs.label: C

questions.en: Summarizing can help readers check their understanding.
questions.zh: 总结可以帮助读者检查自己的理解。
questions.explanation: C 段明确提到，用自己的话解释主旨有助于检验理解程度。
questions.evidence: Explaining the main idea in your own words helps you check your understanding.

questions.en: An established routine can serve as a reminder to read.
questions.zh: 已有的日常安排可以提醒我们阅读。
questions.explanation: A 段说明，将阅读与现有习惯联系起来，可以提醒自己坚持阅读。
questions.evidence: Connecting reading to an existing routine can help you remember to do it.

instructions: 为每条陈述选择包含对应信息的段落。此处为简短题型示例，非真题。
